run_calc_chrf_main: run the script to calculate chrF scores for gender bias analysis across multiple languages
run_obtain_metric_scores: run obtain_metric_scores from calc_chrf_utils to compute chrF metrics for a given language and gender group
run_gender_bias_analysis: run gender bias analysis on MMHB dataset nouns for EN-to-XX and XX-to-EN translation directions
run_eval_nouns_filter: run the script to filter MMHB dataset to eval nouns N051, N052, N063, N064
run_chrf_for_languages: run chrF metric calculation for Spanish, French, Indonesian, Portuguese, Hindi, Italian, and Vietnamese
